adjudication.rationale: The diff shows in addGuests.handler.ts that attendees are first persisted to the database via prisma.booking.update (lines 85-99), and then later the calendar is updated via eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees (line 155). If the calendar update fails, the database already has the new attendees but the calendar doesn't, leaving them inconsistent. There's no transaction wrapping both operations and no rollback/compensation logic if the calendar update fails.
